title: On minimal noncommutative rings
summary: We study minimal noncommutative rings, that is noncommutative rings whose proper subrings and homomorphic images are all commutative. These rings were introduced by Bell and Danchev in order to test commutativity theorems. They raised the problems of describing all such rings in the finite and infinite cases. In the finite case, we give a classification into three pairwise disjoint classes, the first two of which are completely characterised.
